en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a stream or river flowing through a rocky canyon with hills in the background. On the right side, several people sit on large rock outcrops above the water, surrounded by natural vegetation. The card has printed captions in red ink, including the site name at the bottom and publisher/printing details along the sides, plus a red handwritten or printed number in the lower-right margin.
